description: Office of the Governor- Uva Province - Dissolved the Uva Province Pravincil Council From 0810.2019
reasoning: This gazette announces the dissolution of the Uva Province Provincial Council upon completion of its five-year term, which is an electoral process matter directly related to the administration of provincial councils as defined in the Constitution. This falls under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns the dissolution of an elected body and the electoral cycle.
